title: One boat, two critical incidents
description: Only one rescue boat remains available while both Zone B and Zone C need boats. The engine must assign it to at most one incident per plan, and the database must reject a second approval that tries to reserve it again.
expected: Within every plan, BOAT-005 appears at most once
The other incident receives an unmet requirement and a shortage entry
Approving a second action that includes BOAT-005 returns HTTP 409 and leaves exactly one active assignment
